recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the seed reconciliation; the later Transport clean-up issues can remain separate audit items if encountered, but they support this fix and do not require a different source change for FHIR-39512.
issue_request: FHIR-39512 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It required Transport to be treated as an Event resource by keeping instantiatesCanonical renamed as instantiates, removing instantiatesUri, restricting basedOn to the approved request/Task targets, removing intent and priority, and removing request-pattern statements and mappings.
initial_application: Commit 747bf88902d857ee5e0f9dd4df216cccc62b5949 performed the main element changes: renamed instantiatesCanonical, removed instantiatesUri, removed Transport.intent and Transport.priority, and narrowed Transport.basedOn target profiles. Later applied Transport issues removed more request elements and mappings. The current source still retained stale request-oriented basedOn/narrative prose and orphaned TransportIntent terminology that only supported the removed Transport.intent element.
additional_context: Transport is active in source/fhir.ini for the current build. OO minutes record the FHIR-39512 vote and later refer to FHIR-39512 as the removal of request-related Transport elements. Later Jira issues FHIR-50911, FHIR-51849, and FHIR-53052 support the same event-only direction and do not supersede it.
reconciliation: Updated Transport.basedOn and its Event mapping-exception source to describe authorizing requests fulfilled by a transport event, updated the Transport introduction to describe Transport as recording the event rather than being used as the request, quoted an existing image width attribute so the edited XHTML is well-formed, and deleted the orphaned TransportIntent CodeSystem and ValueSet source files.
source_changes: source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml: reworded Transport.basedOn so it no longer calls Transport a request resource and instead describes authorizing requests fulfilled by the transport event.
source/transport/transport-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the Event mapping-exception source for Transport.basedOn with the updated authoritative definition.

source/transport/transport-introduction.xml: revised request-oriented narrative to state that Transport records movement events linked to authorizing requests, and fixed the existing image width attribute quoting for XML well-formedness.
